title: Singapore Family Holiday
headline: Gardens, the bay and a Sentosa day if the children want one.
description: Four nights in Singapore for families: one hotel, Gardens by the Bay and park days added only when you ask.
image_alt: Singapore skyline and Merlion at night
price_label: Quoted for your family and dates
price_guidance: Family pricing depends on room type, child ages and whether Universal Studios or a night safari is included. Park tickets and international flights sit outside the base figure unless you ask us to include them.
overview: A short family city break. One hotel so you are not packing; Gardens for a shared evening; Sentosa or a wildlife park only if that is the trip you want. Daily load can be lightened for younger children.
highlights: Four nights in one family-friendly hotel.
